loss_reason: Closed-lost due to integration friction. Customer could not allocate engineering cycles to build missing Java/Go SDK features and OpenTelemetry propagation; competitor offered native tracing + SSO connectors out-of-the-box.
notes:
Summary notes (fragmented) - POC -> stalled -> closed-lost:
- Company: Cascade Gateway Systems (payments orchestration for merchants + banks). High compliance bar, PCI-adjacent workflows.
- Team: Head of Platform (Amy R.), CTO (Vikram S.), Security lead (Diane H.).
- Initial interest: deploy private instance in VPC with strict residency for EU customers; use cases = support chat, reranking for transaction dispute docs, fraud signal enrichment.
- POC run (Hosted API): functional results acceptable; reranking improved retrieval precision. Latency OK at 90th percentile for single requests.
- Key technical blockers discovered: 
  * SDK coverage: production teams primarily Java + Go. Redwood Java client lacked session management for streaming; Go client labeled experimental. Engineers unwilling to adopt alpha libs.
  * Tracing/observability: required end-to-end trace_id propagation (service -> Redwood) for incident triage. Needed OpenTelemetry headers respected by runtime and ability to export traces to Honeycomb/Datadog. No standard hooks in runtime.
  * Auth & provisioning: needed SCIM for user provisioning + IdP-initiated SSO and attribute mapping for roles. Security flagged several manual steps in onboarding.
  * Compliance docs: requested ISO attestation + SOC2 in writing; security team asked for encryption-in-transit details tied to KMS usage.
- Internal engineering notes: SE delivered a shim for trace propagation during POC but it was brittle; full platform change estimated 4-6 weeks dev. Customer under a hiring freeze; cannot commit.
- Competitive dynamics: shortlisted Anthropic and Palantir; Anthropic provided official Java SDK + OTel integration in their enterprise offering; Palantir promised managed deployment with SCIM/SSO templates. Cascade chose Anthropic for faster dev lift.
- Sales timeline:
  * 2025-09-15: Lead created, inbound via webinar signup.
  * 2025-10-01: First discovery (Julian) - scoped compliance + residency.
  * 2025-11-19: POC kickoff (hosted).
  * 2025-12-10: Tech deep-dive (SE Marta) - security questions raised, opened SEC-1004.
  * 2026-01-14: Demo + cost estimate shared.
  * 2026-01-28: Request for Java/Go SDK roadmap + OTel plan.
  * 2026-02-08: Verbal pause from procurement (hiring freeze).
  * 2026-02-12: Vendor selected (Anthropic). AE marked as closed-lost pending final email.
- Direct quote: Amy R. (Head of Platform): 'We can't spin up a whole infra sprint just to wire tracing into vendor calls.'
- Action items: Create SDK prioritization ticket; add an "enterprise tracing" feature brief for field; follow-up cadence = 6 months. AE to send standard loss survey (no reply yet).
